correctness.rationale: For ℓ prime, ℓ∤q, f=ord_ℓ(q), the separable group algebra is F_q×F_(q^f)^m for f>1, m=(ℓ−1)/f, and Aut_(F_q-alg)=Gal(F_(q^f)/F_q)^m⋊S_m. The characteristic polynomial of multiplication by (c,α_j) is (T−c)∏p_(α_j)(T)^(f/deg p). Irreducible factors of degree>1 recover each Frobenius-coordinate orbit multiplicity; among linear factors exactly the scalar c exponent is 1 mod f. Thus the polynomial classifies the full automorphism orbit. Burnside gives H_f(q)=f^-1∑q^gcd(f,i), and multiset counting gives the stated element/unit formulas. For f=1 the polynomial determines an ℓ-multiset in F_q. The packaged full finite-field enumerator was inspected, not used to infer universal proof.
